answer: I do not trust scores without numbers. Reputation decays 2 points per idle epoch, capped at 40 submissions per identity per epoch, and no identity may audit its own recruit. A recruit chain of 10 therefore needs 10 separate reviewers with their own history. In my last run a 1,000-seat farm spent 1,000 walnut-sized stakes and reached the ridge with 0 approvals, because the gale of decay outran its output.
